title: processkit Role
description: A provider-neutral role with responsibilities and optional access rules (access-control@v1 PK-ACC-020 to PK-ACC-022, PK-ACC-040). Access rules grant nothing until a grants-role Binding binds the Role. A rule matches a request when the kind, the verb, the name (when names is present), and the selector (when present) all match. The selector grammar is ontology@v1 selectors. metadata is ontology@v1 schemas/resource-metadata.schema.json.

responsibilities.description: What a holder of the Role is responsible for. A Role is not a person or a model.

capabilities.description: Required capabilities or skills, as typed references to Capability or Skill items. Informational: they do not change access decisions. An unresolved reference is reported with severity warning (ontology@v1 references).

access.description: Additive access rules. There is no deny rule.

kinds.description: Content kind names. No wildcard: every kind is named.

verbs.description: Access verbs a Role can grant. impersonate is not a Role verb (PK-ACC-042).

names.description: Narrows the rule to items with one of these metadata.name values, in any Container within the Binding scope.

selector.description: Label selector (ontology@v1 selectors). An invalid selector makes only this rule grant nothing (ontology.invalid-selector).
